description: See what your coding agent did, as a receipt: the last check command result, which changes no journal entry mentions, and each file's record — read from .oculpm/, no network, no LLM.
config.explorerBadges: Mark changed files that no journal entry mentions with `○` in the Explorer.
cmd.continueInTerminal: Continue the next item with claude in the terminal
view.welcome:
No Ocul records in this folder yet. Install the Ocul plugin in Claude Code and your coding agent leaves a record in .oculpm/ after each unit of work.
[Copy the two install lines](command:ocul.copyPluginInstall)
Paste them into a terminal, then start Claude Code in this folder. Once .oculpm/ appears, [reload records](command:ocul.refresh).
Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI connect from the Ocul app's Settings.
cmd.copyPluginInstall: Copy the plugin install lines for Claude Code
config.notifyWhenClaudeWaits: Show a notification once when Claude starts waiting for you (a permission prompt, input, or a question).
